basis: Set 2026-08-15 from the measured schema-v6 per-tier baselines at 1,000 and 10,000 agents on Apple M1 Max. Each limit is a bar with headroom over the WORSE of the two scales, not a restatement of either. Note the stall rate is non-monotonic in scale (S2 0.2917/km at 1K against 0.2202/km at 10K), so the worse point is 1K; comparing a larger run against 10K alone would overstate its regression. Headroom rule: 3x for stall_episodes_per_agent_km, which is a well-sampled rate (1,455 episodes at 10K); ~20x for mean_penetration_depth_fraction, which is not (99 penetration agent-ticks in 1.65e8 at 10K, and zero deep contacts at any scale yet run) and so is a blowup detector rather than a precision limit. Two figures that were gated before 2026-08-15 are now reported only: stalled_agent_share is a lifetime cumulative probability and max_penetration_depth_m is an extremum over samples, so both rise with population at unchanged solver behaviour and a fixed limit on either is silently stricter at each larger scale. See docs/benchmarks/2026-08-15-m5-100k-scale-invariance.md. The rejected fixed-lane cadence candidate in 2026-08-13-m5-10k-failed-baseline.md still fails max_stall_agent_ticks_per_agent_tick.
